report_summary: A careful report separates self-labels from operator identity, static probes from successful compromise, and deletion operations from unique keys. It gives a useful repeated-delete/save example and preserves benchmark-score uncertainty. Its closing description of pages.jsonl as post-extract live state is not supported by the archive.
